title: Cove Hollow Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in the heart of 30A's beautiful Watercolor Community, Cove Hollow is a gorgeous private oasis with 5 spacious bedrooms, designer bathrooms & kitchen, private pool with built-in grill and a guest house to top it all off!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located at 130 Cove Hollow in Watercolor's Lake District. It is 0.7 miles to the beach - a quick 10 minute walk or easy bike ride! - Access to the 5 pools in Watercolor including the popular Camp Watercolor and the Beach Club - 2 adult sized beach cruisers - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Fully stocked kitchen - Access to Private Watercolor Beach Access with seasonal tram service - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Pet fee of $150 -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($200 fee applies at booking) Located in the heart of 30A's beautiful Watercolor Community, Cove Hollow is a beautiful private oasis with 5 spacious bedrooms, designer bathrooms & kitchen, private pool with built-in grill and a guest house to top it all off! Don't let the exterior fool you, this cottage sleeps 12 comfortably with space for 4 more in the guest cottage (extra rental rates are required for guest cottage)! You can rent the main cottage by itself or the main house and guest house together. Inquire for more details. Guest house does not get rented to another guest if you do not rent it with the main house. ***IMPORTANT NOTE: the HOA only allows 12 beach bands TOTAL for the use of both homes, and bands are required for any guest older than 5, so please keep this in mind if you have more than 12 in your group as you will not get more than 12 beach bands. Bands are required for entry onto the Watercolor beaches and pools.*** Private pool cannot be heated. You will be greeted by a 2-story open living space upon entering Cove Hollow. A gourmet kitchen with granite counter tops, stainless appliances, and all the appliances you will need to make dining in on your vacation as enjoyable as possible. Two bar stools at the island offer additional breakfast seating with an eat-in dining table on the other side of the kitchen giving way to 6 more dining seats. The screen porch has another table for 6 and if you want the best views in the house, you can eat at the table for 4 out by private pool (not able to heat in colder months) with ample deck space, lounging chairs. An outdoor shower is also available. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 12) First Floor: Bedroom 1: Master Suite- King bed, flat screen cable TV with designer bathroom -stand alone tub and separate shower, and dual sinks with granite counter tops. Bedroom 2: Queen bed, flat screen TV, with full en-suite bath Hallway half bath, kitchen, dining and great room Second Floor: Bedroom 3: Queen bed, flat screen TV, en-suite full bathroom with tub/shower combo Bedroom 4: Queen bed, flat screen TV, en-suite full bathroom with tub/shower combo Bedroom 5: Two twin over twin bunk room that sleeps 4 comfortably is at the end of the hallway. Across the pool deck is Cove Hollow's guest house. The guest house has a queen bedroom, separate full bathroom (bath/shower), a living room with pull-out sofa, and a kitchenette complete with mini-fridge, dishwasher, and microwave. This guest cottage is never rented out separately. You can add the cottage for $75/night. ** ALL quotes and pricing listed are for the 5 BR main house ONLY (sleeps 12 : 1 king suite, 3 queen suites and a room with 2 bunks). Guest cottage requires extra charges (sleeps 4 : 1 queen suite and 1 pull-out sofa)!! Please make sure to ask us directly for pricing on guest cottage. If booked online we will assume you are only renting the main house only unless otherwise specified** ** PET FRIENDLY with $150 non-refundable pet fee (per pet) for non-shedding dogs under 30lbs ** Includes access the 5 community pools (including the Beach Club and Camp Watercolor) as well as beach access ** 2 bikes are included with this rental FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
